set.body: Goal: promote PanelMargins/PanelLayout from a fixed panel contract into a plot layout solver that allocates panel, axis, legend, and future facet-strip regions. Acceptance: layout produces stable named viewports/frames; guide placement no longer relies on hard-coded legend coordinates in domain adapters; clipping policy remains explicit; tests cover panel-only, axes, legend, and design-event plot layout on JVM and JS.
set.title: Graphics: add real plot layout solver
